sets.title: A school day
sets.description: Thói quen học tập, giờ giấc, đồ dùng và hoạt động tại trường.

reading.title: Mai at Riverside School
reading.text:
Mai is twelve years old. She lives near Riverside School and walks there with her brother. Their first lesson starts at eight o’clock. Mai likes English because she enjoys learning new words. On Tuesdays, she brings a small dictionary to class.

At lunchtime, Mai and her friend Anna eat in the school garden. Mai has rice and vegetables, while Anna has a cheese sandwich. After lunch, they visit the library. Students can borrow two books at a time and must return them after one week.

School finishes at four o’clock. Mai plays badminton on Wednesdays, but on other days she goes straight home. In the evening, she does her homework before dinner. She packs her school bag before going to bed.

questions.explanation: Mai walks to school with her brother, tức là đi bộ.

sets.title: At the weekend market

reading.title: A Saturday shopping list
reading.text:
On Saturday morning, Ben and his mother go to a market near their home. They take two cloth bags because they do not want to use plastic bags. Their shopping list includes apples, carrots, bread and milk.

At the fruit stall, apples cost two pounds a kilo. Ben’s mother buys two kilos. The seller gives Ben a small orange to try. Ben likes it, but they do not buy oranges because there are some at home. Next, they buy a loaf of brown bread from a bakery. The bread is still warm.

Before going home, they stop at a café. Ben orders a glass of water, and his mother has a cup of tea. They sit outside for ten minutes. At home, Ben puts the milk in the fridge and helps his mother prepare lunch.

sets.title: A weekend in Green Town
sets.description: Đọc lịch trình, phương tiện, chỉ đường và kể chuyến đi đã qua.

reading.title: Linh and Tom visit Green Town
reading.text:
Last Sunday, Linh and Tom travelled to Green Town by train. They left at nine in the morning, and the journey took forty minutes. At the station, they bought a map from a small information desk.

First, they walked to the town museum. It was opposite the library, next to a flower shop. The museum opened at ten, so they waited in a nearby park for twenty minutes. Inside, they saw old photographs and learnt about the town’s first railway. Tickets were free for students.

For lunch, they ate vegetable noodles at a restaurant by the river. In the afternoon, they rented bicycles and rode to a lake. It started to rain at three, so they returned the bicycles and took a bus back to the station. Linh enjoyed the museum most, while Tom liked the bicycle ride. They arrived home before dinner.

questions.explanation: Câu đầu cho biết họ đến Green Town bằng tàu hỏa.
